messages:
Mira: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners and short ETAs for a small set of rollout safety controls so SRE can schedule work this sprint. Items: 1) auto-rollback hysteresis based on error spikes/ooms 2) per-service rollout percent caps with override audit 3) canonical canary gate schema + validator 4) pre-rollout smoke check + runbook checklist. Claim or split and add a one-line plan + ETA.

Joel: I'll take #1. Plan: implement hysteresis config in orch: window_s, threshold_pct, min_qps, cooldown. Prototype PR by Wed, staging test Thu.

Benji: I'll take #2. Plan: add `service_rollout_caps` table and middleware in flag service; default caps (3% high-risk, 10% regular). Admin override requires two approvers in Console. Backend PR by Thu, console UI Fri.

Lina: I'll own #3 and help with observability tiles. Plan: define simple JSON gate schema (metric, baseline, factor, window_s, action) and validator in canary controller. PoC + dashboard tile by next Tue.

Samir: I'll update the runbook and add the smoke harness for #4. Small smoke job: 3 synthetic calls + golden check. Runbook draft by Fri, harness PR next week.

deploy-bot: FYI last night's rollback failed to trigger because no hysteresis was configured; canary ramped from 0->50% in 2m.

Mira: Decision: defaults enforced with opt-out requiring documented risk review + two approvers. Also block any rollout plan that increases step above `max_step_percent` if no gates present. Benji please add `require_gates` default true for prod.

Joel: Will add short RFC snippet for rollback hysteresis and event payloads.

Benji: Opening DB schema PR tonight.

Lina: Posting PoC notes here when ready.

Samir: Scheduling 30m follow-up Fri 10am to review PRs. Invite sent.

Mira: I'll make the incident tracker INC-2301 and add owners/dates. Drop PR links there and tag me. :white_check_mark:
